gate.caveat: Test IoU inflated by synthetic Δσ⁰ label leakage. The Δσ⁰ channel is constructed from water labels (flood drop = -8 dB + noise) during training, which encodes the answer in the input. The architecture is sound — retrain with real paired pre/post SAR (Kuro Siwo / S1GFloods) to get an honest test IoU. At inference, real paired SAR via pre_sar_dir eliminates this leakage.
